description: This file implements a custom React hook `useApi` for managing asynchronous API calls with features such as loading state, error handling, cancellation, and timeout support. It handles standardized error shapes and provides utility functions for making requests and resetting state.

methods.name: useApi(fn, config = {})
methods.description: A reusable React hook for managing async API requests with support for loading state, errors, cancellation, and timeouts. It accepts an async function and optional configuration, returning status indicators, data, and control functions.
